Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Hey... What do you think of small girls...？
Well, they can be a little cheeky sometimes, but for the most part I like them. They're cute, right？
Cheeky...？ I see.
Whenever I play with my younger relatives, they're just kids, but sometimes they say the most grown-up things.
Huh？ ...Is that not what you meant？
...I see. You meant little kids.
What are you talking about？ Did I get the wrong idea again？
...Well, never mind.
Don't just settle it in your own head. That's weird.
Kobayakawa
When you're dating someone, does a height difference... bother you？
Where did that come from all of a sudden？
This is about someone I know, though.
Yeah.
Apparently, when you're walking side by side on a date, being short makes you really self-conscious.
▲小早川＊▲. Does that sort of thing bother you？
Like I said, it's not about me. It's about someone I know.
I don't really get why that would bother anyone, though.
You know, like the difference in your stride when you walk.
I always try to match your pace, ▲小早川＊▲, but was I walking too fast...？
You match my pace...？ Oh, I didn't realize.
So I really don't think you need to worry about that.
I see... I'll pass that on to this person I know.
Someone you know, huh.
Yeah... Someone I know.
About that height thing... Is it still bothering you？
Kobayakawa
I told you, it's about someone I know.
Ah, right.
...Yeah.
Still, once you fall for someone, little things like that usually don't matter at all, right？
You think so？
I mean, almost nobody decides whether to date someone based on how tall or short they are.
I see. That's a little reassuring.
So it really was bothering you.
...Well... a little. ...You know... like when we kiss and stuff...
...Oh, that's what you mean. Still, I really like how you stretch up on your tiptoes whenever we kiss.
...Pervert.
How does that make me a pervert...？
You seem really hung up on it, but if you're short, being short—
Ow!
Kobayakawa
Stop calling me short over and over.
...Well, being petite has its good points too, doesn't it？
Like what...？
You know, like how easy it is to carry you like a princess... Hey, come on, don't get mad.
I'm not mad.
Then why are you making that face？
Being carried like a princess... I wonder what that feels like. ...Uh, never mind, forget I said that.
So you are curious about it？
Well, I am a girl, after all... Not that I'm asking you to do it or anything.
Why not？ If you want me to, I'll do it for you anytime, you know？
That's just... embarrassing.
Wouldn't it be fine if no one's watching？
Yeah, then maybe... Wait, why am I getting swept up in this too...？ Ugh, you're an idiot.
(She could just be honest and say she wants me to do it.)
Kobayakawa
Hey. If you got married, would you want to go on a honeymoon？
...W-Where did that come from all of a sudden？
Don't get the wrong idea. I'm talking about my dad and... my mom.
Haven't they gone on a trip or anything since they got remarried？
Forget a honeymoon, they haven't even gone away for a single night.
Are they busy with work or something？
There's that, too, but I think it's more that they feel they can't leave the kids behind.
Right. Your little brother is still pretty young, isn't he？
Yeah. If it were just me, I wouldn't mind them leaving me home alone, though.
Leaving a girl home all by herself, even for a short trip, probably isn't a good idea.
I'm used to... being alone. Besides... I have you now, too.
Get your mind out of the gutter. I never said anything about inviting you over.
So if someone could look after your brother, they'd be able to go on a honeymoon...
Kobayakawa
It's not that simple. My dad is one thing, but... my mom tends to be a worrier.
Hmm...
What？ Did I say something weird!？
I was just thinking how naturally you call her "Mom" now.
...You're an idiot. Mom is... Mom.
Yeah. I can't stay a kid forever, you know.
I'm really glad for you, that you've become a real family.
You know, if you keep talking like my guardian all the time, you're gonna get old fast？
Kobayakawa
Anyway, I figured we could go as a family if it's a hot spring nearby, so I picked up some brochures earlier.
Huh. They really have all kinds of plans these days.
Yeah. If it's nearby, they have overnight packages, so it's easier to schedule, too.
A couples-only mixed-bathing tour... huh.
Stop picking out all the weird ones, you giant pervert.
I just happened to spot this one by chance!!
Yeah, right...
More importantly, have you actually talked to your parents about this yet？
Not yet. I haven't really found the right time to bring it up...
Still, you should at least bring it up with them as soon as you can. You can't exactly decide everything on your own.
Yeah, I know. I'll bring it up when I get home today.
Kobayakawa
...I just got a call from home.
From home...？ Did something happen...？
Yeah... She started crying on me.
Eh？
Since I'd been looking through travel magazines and stuff, she could kind of tell I was hiding something.
At first she was worried sick that I might run away from home again... So I told her the truth.
And that made her cry over the phone...
Yeah. Though she said she was crying because she was happy...
She didn't have to cry over it. I'm their daughter—of course I want my parents to be happy...
I see. Shouldn't you head home to them soon, then？
...Yeah. Mom said... we should all plan the trip together as a family today.
Really？ That's great.
Yeah. I'll let you know how it goes later.
You don't need to worry about me. I hope you get to go on that trip.
...Mhm, thanks.
Kobayakawa
I've been wondering lately... What am I gonna be doing ten years from now？
Before, I couldn't care less about the future... but lately it's been on my mind.
Could that be thanks to me？
Don't flatter yourself. ...Though you might've had a little influence on it.
▲小早川＊▲ ten years from now, huh. Think you'll be an office worker or something？ ...Nah, I can't see it.
What do you mean by that？
Just that... you don't really fit into a mold, I guess... Something like that.
That makes zero sense. Though in ten years, you're definitely gonna be a total old man.
...Come on, I won't be that bad.
I mean mentally. Keep fussing over other people all the time and you'll age fast, you know？
...And whose fault is it that I have to fuss？
Did you say something？
Nothing.
Going back to that ten-years-from-now thing, what did you actually have in mind, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Hmm... That's a tough question.
Try thinking about what you want to be in the future.
Okay, a martial artist.
...Seriously？
As if. Did you almost buy that？
I always see you playing fighting games, so I couldn't help it.
Sigh... Dealing with people who can't tell reality from fiction, I swear...
You don't have to put it like that. So what do you actually want to be？
...It's a secret.
Kobayakawa
Forget about me in ten years—what do you think you'll be doing？
Me, huh... Playing it safe as an office worker, maybe？
Nothing wrong with that, I guess. Don't you have any bigger dreams？ That's the exact kind of thing that makes you sound like an old man.
A dream, huh... If I have a warm, happy family, I think that alone would be enough for me.
...Yeah, I kinda get that.
Huh.
Is it weird？ Before, I thought there was no way I'd ever get married, but...
Is that because your dad got remarried？
Maybe that's part of it. But it's not just that... Actually, never mind.
Come on, don't stop halfway through.
Shut up. ...You're so dense.
About ten years from now... That's not fair. Stop dodging the question already.
Kobayakawa
...A bride.
Hehe, surprised you!
What, you were just joking？
I'm not really joking. I'll probably get married someday, won't I？
Yeah, I guess so...
Wait, are you jealous of my future husband？
...Who knows.
Hehe, you'd better work hard, then!
Work hard at what？
Who knows!
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, is there anything you've been into lately？
Kobayakawa
I've been watching cat videos online almost every day.
Huh. Every day？
Yeah. I watch them every day and never get tired of them.
They each have their own personality. Some are sassy, some are timid, and their reactions are all different.
Watching them just makes me want to squeeze them tight.
You really do love cats, ▲小早川＊▲.
There's just one problem, though. ...I'm losing sleep over it every night.
You might want to tone it down a bit.
Yeah, I know. But before I realize it, I've been watching for hours. Being that cute ought to be a crime...
By the way, do you only use the internet to watch videos？
Kobayakawa
...Yeah. I don't really look at much else. It's my dad's computer to begin with.
Oh, so you don't play games online or anything.
With fighting games, it's more fun crushing your opponent in person at the arcade.
Crush them...? Come on, you're still a girl, you know.
When I'm playing a fighting game, I'm not a girl. I'm a fighter.
Even though you only ever pick girl characters in versus.
Winning with some bulky guy isn't pretty at all. It's a matter of principle.
Kobayakawa
Oh, speaking of the internet, they just put an unreleased Killer Bambis track online.
Oh, the one that's always on your music player, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah. It's a live recording this time, and it's not overly edited. That raw, gritty feel makes it sound so real.
Come to think of it, do you ever go to concerts, ▲小早川＊▲？
Killer Bambis never come to Japan. And I can't exactly go overseas to see them.
I see. Oh, plus in a crowded venue, ▲小早川＊▲, you'd...
In a packed venue, I'd what？ Are you trying to say I'd get trampled？
I didn't even say anything yet.
Don't worry. When we go to a concert, I'll protect you.
Kobayakawa
...Okay. Um, when we do, would it be okay if I held onto your hand...？
Of course I did.
Also... I wonder how I can grow taller.
People always say drinking milk helps, right？
...I've been doing that the whole time. I haven't grown at all, though.
Do you really want to get taller that badly？
When you put it like that, it makes me sound desperate.
Still, you'd be happy if you grew taller, right？
Well... You know, when I'm walking with my boyfriend... we'd match better, right？
Huh？ I think you're totally fine just the way you are right now, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh... I see.
You don't have to force yourself to match me. You're fine as you are, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Thanks. That makes me feel a little better.
